window_length_variance_note: k-means runs on standardised (SFI, window_days); window_days is strongly bimodal (median 55-64 vs 147), so the profiles are close to a split on window length alone.
caveat: Profile labels come from k-means on (SFI, window length) with no outcome input. ``within_window_fail_spread`` is the largest fail-share spread between profiles inside one window-length bucket: if it is small, the profiles mostly proxy window length and do not reproduce the published high/low/sporadic delayer typology.
